materialPolicy: Only visible hard-surface boundaries are accepted. Asphalt is a plausible visual finish for confirmed pavement; no chemical/composition claim. Pale ambiguous surfaces are paved-unspecified and receive no formal bay paint. Explicit unpaved service ways remain unpaved.
widthPolicy: Mapped service-road width is used when available. Otherwise3.2m driveway or4.8m service circulation width is an authored assumption, gated by explicit paved tags or strong pre-existing impervious support. No new guided route or public-access claim.
